title: How does the origin accept only CloudFront?
claim: The kind of origin decides how you keep viewers from going around CloudFront.
alt: A decision ladder. An S3 bucket through its REST endpoint leads to origin access control. A load balancer or instance that can be private leads to a VPC origin. An internet-facing load balancer leads to a prefix list and a custom header. Anything else leads to custom headers or origin mutual TLS.

rungs.q: S3 bucket used through its REST endpoint?
Can the load balancer or instance be private?
Must the load balancer stay internet-facing?
